content: In order to understand which sections of the discharge summaries would be the easiest or most difficult to summarize, we performed the same CUI overlap comparison for the chief complaint, major surgical or invasive procedure, discharge medication, and history of present illness sections of the discharge note separately. We calculated which fraction of the CUIs in each section were located in the rest of the patient's note for a specific hospital stay. We also calculated what percent of the genders recorded in the discharge summary were also recorded in the structured data for the patient.
